findings.place: Last narrative line before (11), spelling of connait before ce germe
findings.ink: A compact detached round dot stands above the i. There is no detached roof or two-sided circumflex; the tall rise immediately to the right is joined to the terminal t and belongs to that letter. Preserve the literal dotted-i spelling connait instead of the circumflex supplied by both witnesses. This is a different word from the ce-versus-son comparison already recorded in D05, which remains unchanged.
